label: EnigmaIOT Test Flow
info:
Flow to test EnigmaIOT API from Node-RED
- Set gateway IP using the Set gateway IP inject (stores in flow context)
- Use inject buttons or the dashboard dropdown
- HTTP Request node uses msg.method and msg.url (2 outputs) for success/error handling

name: Build Node Dropdown
Generate query
func:
let nodeName = msg.payload;

msg.query = `
from(bucket: "tani_bucket")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensordata")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node == "${nodeName}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "voltage" or
      r._field == "temperature" or
      r._field == "power" or
      r._field == "luminosity" or
      r._field == "humidity" or
      r._field == "analog_in"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
`;

return msg;
